Today, Paradise Island has been added, several updates have been made, and the Aurora feature has been introduced.

notes.title: DevLog 5
notes.content:
[h3]Update[/h3]

An update has been carried out today, featuring a particularly important new addition that affects all current and future players, regardless of their hardware: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3.

To ensure that these features work smoothly, it is important to reset your graphics settings once. Any changes to the graphics settings should be followed by a restart to ensure that the settings are applied correctly.

Thanks to AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3, performance improvements can now be achieved. This feature optimizes performance and is available for both AMD and Nvidia graphics card users.

Enable FSR and select your quality level, ranging from Native AA to Ultra Performance.

FSR allows older PCs to achieve enhanced image clarity and performance even with lower graphics settings.

notes.title: DevLog 4
notes.content:
[h3]Update[/h3]

Today, an update was released that also takes into account the desire for faster movement.

- Some users have asked for the ability to run in the game. However, we want to remind you that it is a "Relaxing Simulator." Therefore, we have found a compromise: you can now walk normally and walk a bit faster, but real running is not possible.

- Additionally, we have considered the request for snow. You now have the option to change the weather to snow, and the environment reacts accordingly. You can walk through the snow and leave tracks that will gradually be covered by falling snow.

- All weather options now have an impact on the environment. For example, trees move when it is windy, just as they do in rain or snow.

- Furthermore, a small bug in the weather settings menu has been fixed, where the current weather setting was not displayed when revisiting.

[h3]Demo[/h3]

The demo has now also been updated accordingly!

notes.title: Positive Reception
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community[/b],

It's amazing that this small game "Relaxing Simulator" is well received by many users. Currently, there are only a few reviews, but I am confident that this will change in the future.

The Relaxing Simulator was developed by me, also as an experimental project, to see if such a game could even spark interest among users. Indeed, the Relaxing Simulator has piqued users' interest, which has pleasantly surprised me.

[b]General[/b]

Due to the demand for faster walking and additional sounds, I want to inform you that these features will be integrated into future updates.

Furthermore, snow and forest areas are being planned, which can be larger to allow for virtual walks through forests or mountains.

[b]Videos and Screenshots[/b]

Numerous videos and screenshots are appearing, and the number of ideas and email requests continues to increase. You can also post these videos or screenshots in my Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/8zyKXj9SDr]Discord[/url]

[b]Ideas and Wishes[/b]

I would like to thank you again for your interest and the submission of ideas and wishes. They help me make this game unique.

- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2965380/discussions/]CommunityHUB[/url] 
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2965380/discussions/1/]Ideas and Wishes[/url] 

[b]VR Support[/b]

Some have asked about VR support. I would like to offer VR but want to first see if the interest in VR is really significant. Currently, I lack the equipment to implement VR, as I have rarely dealt with VR in the course of my developments. However, I am willing to change that.

[b]Curators & Streamers[/b]

I receive numerous requests for keys. I am always happy to provide keys for promotional support. Unfortunately, it often happens that developers receive many fake requests, making it increasingly difficult to distinguish whether it is the actual owner of the curator, YouTube, or Twitch channel. I often prefer to work with my own community, where I can ensure that it is the actual owners.

[b]Achievements[/b]

I want to offer more achievements in the future. The biggest achievement in Relaxing Simulator is the 1000-hour achievement. That sounds like a lot, but it is meant to be a challenge. My goal is to foster long-term customer loyalty and give players an incentive to enjoy the game repeatedly. This also includes significant achievements.

It is important to me that the achievements in Relaxing Simulator provide a genuine sense of reward and are not just quickly and easily attainable. However, I will reconsider the achievements in terms of the number of hours and possibly reduce them.

[b]Furthermore, I wish you a good relaxation.[/b]

notes.title: Release of Our New Relaxing Simulator on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players[/b],

Today is a very special day for us – our Relaxing Simulator is finally launching on Steam! We are very excited to present our new game to you, designed to offer a relaxing and peaceful environment to enjoy.

As we were concerned about whether this game would generate interest, we initially provided small maps and fewer features. As an indie studio, it's challenging to conduct surveys for this type of game to gather feedback on potential interest. Often, we have to take a leap of faith and hope that everything works out as we envisioned.

In our Relaxing Simulator, it's not about completing tasks or overcoming challenges. Instead, you can simply immerse yourself in the environment and discover small, interactive elements. We would like to inform you that the game does not include a story, characters, racing, or jumping mechanics. You move by standing and walking forward and are on mini-maps. It is a tranquil experience where the focus is on exploring and enjoying the surroundings.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2965380/Relaxing_Simulator/

[b]Our Goal: A Digital Sanctuary[/b]

With this game, we aim to create places that transport you to experiences that are not always possible in real life. Our goal is to create a digital sanctuary where players can take a break from everyday stress. With a harmonious combination of visual aesthetics, relaxing music, and soothing activities, we invite players to leave the hustle and bustle of life behind and dive into a world of inner peace. Welcome to our Relaxing Simulator - a place where relaxation and recovery are at the forefront.

[b]It's Different, but Exciting[/b]

It's definitely a bit different from what you usually expect in a game, but I see it as a chance to present something fresh and exciting for you.

[b]Try the Demo![/b]

Before deciding to buy the game, we recommend trying the free demo. This way, you can see if the Relaxing Simulator meets your expectations and preferences. Please keep in mind that if you don't enjoy the demo, the full game likely won't interest you either.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974720

[b]More:[/b]

[list]
[*]At launch, various environments are available, and with the integrated leaderboard, you can see which environments are the most popular. Your feedback is very important to us to better tailor the game's development to user preferences.
[*]Do you love this game and want additional environments to relax in? Share your ideas in the CommunityHUB and let’s discuss them together.
[*]Additionally, you can take great screenshots and share them on Steam to capture your favorite moments in the game.
[/list]
We hope our Relaxing Simulator brings a little peace and relaxation to your daily life. Thank you for your support and enjoy exploring!

notes.title: Only a few days left until the release!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community,[/b]

It’s amazing that there are only a few days left until the release of "Relaxing Simulator." A lot of passion and hard work has gone into the development of this game, and we can’t wait for you to finally try it out. Our goal was to create a relaxing and soothing experience that helps you escape from everyday life.

I hope that "Relaxing Simulator" will spark interest in many users. With lovingly designed environments, calming music, and interactive elements, I want to offer you an oasis of tranquility. I’m looking forward to your feedback and am excited to embark on this journey with you.

Stay tuned and look forward to a relaxing break with "Relaxing Simulator"!

notes.title: Age Restriction
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community,[/b]

I wanted to ensure that our game is suitable for all age groups. Unfortunately, this is not possible because the game contains various environments that may not be appropriate for every age group.

Some content such as tobacco or wine bottles as well as slightly scary environments or environments that appear scary to the person, such as scenarios with thunderstorms that can be set by the user, could affect the age restriction. There is a possibility that the minimum age for our game will be raised to 16 by the time of release.

The environments may not be suitable for every age group as player preferences vary and we will try to include a wide range of environments in the future.

There will be eight different environments available at release. Please note that this is a (Relaxing Simulator) and not a puzzle solving game. You can explore the environment, look at items, take Steam screenshots or enjoy the sunrise and sunset.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Pure Relaxation: The Relaxing Simulator is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community,[/b]

I am thrilled to introduce you to the "Relaxing Simulator" game. I hope many of you will enjoy it. The Relaxing Simulator is designed to provide relaxation for all age groups, whether you simply want to stroll around, contemplate things, or enjoy the environment.

[b]Features:[/b]

- Experience complete freedom in the first-person perspective and move around freely.
- Enjoy the environment with music or ambient sounds.
- Choose from 8 different environments.
- Interact with objects, furniture, and doors to actively explore the world.
- Adjust the weather to tailor the atmosphere of your environment to your preferences.

[b]Special Features:[/b]

- Earn numerous achievements through various challenges.
- A global leaderboard shows how long you've enjoyed your peace and quiet.

[b]More:[/b]

If there's an environment missing that you would like to see, let me know in the Community Hub. I'll make a note of your suggestions and provide them as updates later on. However, please keep in mind that these environments should be suitable for everyone, and not every environment can be provided due to lack of interest or similar reasons.

[b]Note:[/b]

The game has no storyline, characters, racing, jumping, or similar elements. You move around standing or walking forward and are situated on mini-maps.
